released_ELF_policy: Official runner hashes before/after native execution and records release. Retired bytes are not claimed present or archived.
binary_binding_policy: Recorded actual closure-time V8b observations; large mutable producers/runtime/ELFs are not reopened or included. Later all-features Cargo may legitimately replace producer paths.
focused_provenance_policy: The focused 40-PASS checkpoint and its two earlier RED attempts remain separate and are not counted as additional full-workspace executions.
raw_path_identity: Each raw stream is keyed by (original_path, expected SHA256). Four historical watcher versions and all sixteen current detached captures coexist with exact original paths. The actual V8b audit and published f5 portable checkpoint bind their provenance.
decode: Existing V7 pack encoding: base64 then zlib, exact byte count and SHA256. Exact current audit and content-addressed raw files round-trip. Standalone verifier checks all107 default metadata scopes, actual qualified IDs/partition unions, actual Cargo/source provenance, all9120 previous PASS IDs and all70 controls. No retired binary presence claim.
